description: A Java class that provides side-effect free summary calculations for savings account transactions, including totals for deposits, withdrawals, interest, fees, penalties, overdraft interest, and tax withholdings.

classes.name: SavingsAccountTransactionDataSummaryWrapper
classes.description: A final class providing methods to calculate total amounts for various transaction types related to savings accounts, without side effects.

methods.name: calculateTotalDeposits
methods.description: Calculates total deposit and dividend payout amounts from a list of transactions.

methods.name: calculateTotalWithdrawals
methods.description: Calculates total withdrawal amounts from a list of transactions.

methods.name: calculateTotalInterestPosted
methods.description: Calculates total interest posted amounts from a list of transactions.

methods.name: calculateTotalWithdrawalFees
methods.description: Calculates total withdrawal fee amounts from a list of transactions.

methods.name: calculateTotalAnnualFees
methods.description: Calculates total annual fee amounts from a list of transactions.

methods.name: calculateTotalFeesCharge
methods.description: Calculates total fee charge amounts from a list of transactions.

methods.name: calculateTotalFeesChargeWaived
methods.description: Calculates total waived fee charge amounts from a list of transactions.

methods.name: calculateTotalPenaltyCharge
methods.description: Calculates total penalty charge amounts from a list of transactions.

methods.name: calculateTotalPenaltyChargeWaived
methods.description: Calculates total waived penalty charge amounts from a list of transactions.

methods.name: calculateTotalOverdraftInterest
methods.description: Calculates total overdraft interest amounts from a list of transactions.

methods.name: calculateTotalWithholdTaxWithdrawal
methods.description: Calculates total tax withholding amounts from withdrawal transactions.
